business_summary: Quanta Services, Inc. is a Texas-headquartered, NYSE-listed infrastructure solutions provider operating through Electric Infrastructure Solutions, Renewable Energy Infrastructure Solutions, and Underground Utility and Infrastructure Solutions segments. Electric Infrastructure Solutions designs, builds and maintains electric transmission, distribution, substation and generation-interconnection infrastructure for utility and industrial customers; that segment is the mapped grid-interconnect exposure and, per the located Q2 2026 coverage, accounted for roughly 82% of consolidated revenue in the quarter.

exposure_summary.narrative: Quanta sits on grid-interconnect, scored UNDISCOVERED. Its second-quarter 2026 release reports consolidated revenue up 41.1% year over year to $9.56 billion, with Electric Infrastructure Solutions revenue up 43.6% year over year to $7.84 billion (about 82% of the quarter's total), a record total backlog of $53.4 billion, and raised full-year 2026 guidance across revenue, adjusted EBITDA, adjusted EPS and free cash flow.
